name: Hyvor Relay Open-Source Self-Hosted Email API
free_limit: AGPL-3.0 open-source email API and SMTP delivery software may be self-hosted without a software subscription or per-message software quota; operator supplies mail servers and delivery infrastructure.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires PostgreSQL, workers, SMTP infrastructure, IP reputation, DNS and operational maintenance; provider-hosted Relay Cloud is separate and not included. Modified network-served versions must comply with AGPL-3.0; enterprise commercial licenses are separately paid.
